anchor: 这正是前文中我请大家特别留意的“输出 Token 减少 22%”。
theme: 更少的输出 Token 降低了成本，也可能把必要说明一起压缩掉
prompt: Generate one standalone 16:9 horizontal Chinese article illustration. Pure white background, minimalist black hand-drawn line art, slightly wobbly pen lines, lots of empty white space, no gradients, no shadows, no paper texture, no commercial vector style, no PPT infographic look, no cute mascot poster, no realistic UI. The recurring IP character is 小黑: a small solid-black cat with white dot eyes, pointed ears, short tail, tiny thin legs, blank serious expression, slightly uneven hand-drawn body. 小黑 must perform the core action. Show 小黑 operating an absurd hand-cranked token press: a thick roll labeled only with the short handwritten Chinese label “完整汇报” enters the machine, while a very thin strip labeled “更少 Token” exits. Several small but important note fragments fall through gaps under the press into a red-marked tray labeled “遗漏细节”. A small warm-gold handwritten note says “成本下降”, and one blue note says “过程不可见”. Keep the main subject at 40%-60% of the canvas and preserve at least 35% blank space. Black for line art and 小黑, matte warm gold #A07848 for the crank and output path, red only for the missing-fragment warning, blue only for the secondary visibility note. Use at most four short Chinese handwritten labels. No title in the top-left. One image explains only this trade-off: cheaper output can also compress away useful reporting. Strange but clean, serious rather than cute.

anchor: 目前来看，我会继续使用 Sol 来协助处理具体的代码业务逻辑实现，而在所有涉及前端与 UI 设计的任务中则转向 Claude。
theme: 不同模型各有所长，按任务切换比争论单一赢家更实用
